card.name: Decimal point in p-values
card.fires_on: The decimal point (or leading zero) right after "p =", "p <" or "p ≤ 0" in reported statistical results, just before the digits of the p-value. Also seen on a leading 0 in other numbers.

modes.label: P-value decimal point
modes.description: The period after the 0 in a p-value inside parentheses in trial results.

modes.label: Leading zero in numbers
modes.description: A 0 starting a code or small decimal value, as in a postal code or a change score.

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning "further" across languages, so it seems to steer the output away from continuing prose after the number.
card.plain: It fires on the decimal point in a p-value, such as the dot in p = 0.01, in study results.
